{{Quote|Doc! How's Jessop? He okay?''"<br />"''Your friend suffered from a rakghoul bite.''"<br />"''Just a bite. So he got off easy?''"<br />"''He was infected with the rakghoul plague. During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|attempted resettlement]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], a<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] worked as a '''doctor'''. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}} As the three aforementioned classes can witness the conversation between the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] and [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Taris)|Jessop's friend]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], it must therefore take place in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> they treated the individual known as [[Jessop]], who had been bitten by a [[rakghoul]],<ref name="SWTOR" /> a type of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] that roamed Taris.<ref name="KotOR25">[[Knights of the Old Republic 25|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 25]]</ref>

When it became clear that Jessop had been infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]], which transformed the infected into rakghouls, the [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the patient. While in the settlement of [[Olaris]], the Twi'lek talked to a [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Taris)|Republic soldier]] who had been friends with Jessop. After revealing to the [[Republic soldier|soldier]] their friend's fate, the doctor offered to take them to a grief counselor.<ref name="SWTOR" />

The doctor had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They believed killing Jessop would be better than letting him live as a rakghoul, and attempted to comfort the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] upon telling them of Jessop's death.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The doctor was created for<ref name="SWTOR" /> the [[2011]]<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]]. In the game, the doctor appears as a non-player character only identified as "Weary Doctor."<ref name="SWTOR" />
